scope: Read-only review of summarized claims in the fictional Maine SLD React training activity, not a real eligibility record.
findings: Current Maine Q1-Q9 pathway retained, including Q3 four subparts, Q5/Q6 narratives, Q7 validity review, and distinct Q8/Q9 decisions.
MUSER VII.3 excludes SLD from the separate adverse-effect procedure.
Jordan record explicitly stipulates valid achievement evidence in all eight areas relative to age and grade; the isolated processing score does not override it.

All 52 Alex score labels and values match the original alex_v7_scores.json fixture. WISC primary subtests are scaled scores; other listed scores are standard scores. No derived percentiles or confidence intervals, and no universal-battery requirement.
Multilingual checklist addresses instruction/access, assessment validity, primary cause, timely evaluation, and concurrent ESOL/special education.
All form source IDs resolve. Case tasks, academic areas, Q3 subparts, Q4 streams, debrief cautions and labels are populated in reviewed fields.
